data.narrative:
Pragmatic Semiconductor is a Series D frontier-tech company in Chips & Semiconductors that has raised $231M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 3 public semiconductor names (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private peers spanning similar and adjacent stages, with four direct comparables anchoring the peer-median method: Etched ($5.0B, Series C), Tenstorrent ($2.7B, Series D), d-Matrix ($2.0B, Series C), and DEEPX ($529M, Series C).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis uses total capital raised as a proxy base ($231M) and applies a 1.5x step-up multiplier typical of Series D advancement, implying $346M. Peer-median analysis across the four same-sector comparables yields a median valuation of $2.4B, with a range from $529M to $5.0B. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (median 21.4x across the three public semiconductors) is not applicable given the absence of disclosed revenue for the target.

The two-method triangulation supports a valuation range of $295M (low) to $2.7B (high), with a median of $1.3B. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty around where Pragmatic sits within the peer cohort by stage maturity and technical differentiation. The stage-progression method provides a conservative floor; peer positioning relative to Tenstorrent (same stage, $2.7B) and lower-valued Series C names will be critical to narrowing the range.
